maps.title: Machu Picchu and the Inca heartland
maps.scope: The wider Urubamba landscape, Machu Picchu sanctuary and buffer, Cusco, Ollantaytambo, Pisac and the Vilcabamba–Choquequirao setting. Modern terrain and selected dated atlas places. Major place labels keep this landscape readable; individual buildings are labeled in the close view.

maps.title: Machu Picchu sanctuary and surrounding valleys
maps.scope: The whole sanctuary and surrounding buffer landscape. The Urubamba valley and mountain setting extend well beyond the archaeological city. Administrative boundaries are not drawn by this relief layer. Major place labels keep this landscape readable; individual buildings are labeled in the close view.

maps.title: Chaco Canyon and its outlying landscape
maps.scope: Chaco Canyon and the landscape toward Kin Bineola, Kin Ya’a and Pueblo Pintado. The historical survey maps below show the wider San Juan Basin and ancient road evidence.

maps.title: The San Juan Basin and Chacoan communities
maps.scope: The San Juan Basin between the Farmington area and the Mount Taylor country, including central Chaco and regional great houses. The BLM sheets show the published survey linework.

maps.title: Mesa Verde National Park and its mesas
maps.scope: The full park from the northern rim and entrance to Chapin Mesa, Wetherill Mesa and the southern cliff-dwelling drainages.

maps.title: Cahokia and the American Bottom
maps.scope: The American Bottom floodplain, Mississippi meander belt and surrounding bluffs, with Cahokia as the regional reference. Individual mounds and plazas appear in the close view below.

maps.title: Hopewell Ceremonial Earthworks across southern Ohio
maps.scope: The eight inscribed earthwork sites in the Scioto, Licking and Little Miami valleys, including Newark and Fort Ancient.

maps.title: Poverty Point, Bayou Maçon and its lowlands
maps.scope: The earthworks, the Bayou Maçon ridge and bluff, and the adjacent alluvial landscape.

maps.title: Chan Chan and the Moche Valley coast
maps.scope: The archaeological zone and its coastal valley setting from Huanchaco and the Pacific shore through Trujillo and the Moche River corridor.

maps.title: Canyon de Chelly and Canyon del Muerto
maps.scope: The two canyon systems, their confluence near Chinle, and the adjoining plateau and upstream landscape within Diné homeland.

maps.title: Nan Madol and the Temwen lagoon
maps.scope: The islet complex, Temwen, the adjacent Pohnpei shore and fringing reef. The terrain view provides lagoon-scale context.

maps.title: Aztec Ruins and the Animas River valley
maps.scope: The archaeological complex, the Animas River valley and terraces on both banks.

maps.title: The Budj Bim lava flow and engineered water landscape
maps.scope: The north–south lava-flow and waterway landscape linking Budj Bim, Kurtonitj and Tyrendarra.

maps.title: Northern Idaho river corridors
maps.scope: The Clearwater, Coeur d’Alene and upper Snake country, with prairie gathering places and river crossings in the study area.

maps.title: Rapa Nui and its surrounding waters
maps.scope: The whole island in its ocean setting. The local map brings the coastal settlements, quarry and ceremonial places into view.

maps.title: The mountain valleys of western Montana
maps.scope: The western Montana mountain corridor, including the Bitterroot, upper Missouri and Big Hole country, valley settlements and mountain crossings.

maps.title: The Windward Islands and Barbados
maps.scope: The Windward island and sea corridors from Saint Lucia through the Grenadines to Grenada, with Barbados to the east.

maps.title: Northern inland Louisiana and the Red River
maps.scope: The northern Louisiana interior, including the Red River corridor from the Shreveport area to Natchitoches and nearby settlements.

maps.title: The northwestern Nevada basins
maps.scope: The northwestern Great Basin, including Pyramid Lake, the lower Humboldt wetlands and the Carson River country.

maps.title: The Leeward Islands and neighboring passages
maps.scope: The northern Lesser Antilles, with the Saint Kitts, Antigua, Montserrat and Guadeloupe island settings and intervening sea passages.

maps.title: Venezuela’s rivers, llanos and islands
maps.scope: The Venezuelan study area from the Andean piedmont and llanos to the Orinoco and Caribbean islands, including the coastal waters of the guide.

maps.title: Fiji, Tonga and Samoa across the antimeridian
maps.scope: The southwest Pacific island chains of Fiji, Tonga and Samoa, with their intervening passages and distances in one continuous frame.

maps.title: Baja California and the northern Mexican desert
maps.scope: The Baja California peninsula and Gulf of California setting, with the Sonoran desert and adjacent northern Mexican highlands.

maps.title: The Society, Cook and Marquesas islands
maps.scope: The broad ocean setting of the Society, Cook and Marquesas islands, with the separate island groups and open-water passages visible together.

maps.title: Aotearoa’s islands and coastal landscapes
maps.scope: Te Ika-a-Māui and Te Waipounamu, with coastal and river settings, nearby offshore islands and the strait between the main islands.

maps.title: The Southeast coastal plain and Virginia Tidewater
maps.scope: The Southeast coastal setting through Chesapeake Bay, with the Potomac, York, Pamunkey and James river landscapes in the guide.

maps.title: Northern Central America from Pacific valleys to the Caribbean
maps.scope: The regional setting of El Salvador’s volcanic valleys and Nicaragua’s Pacific lowlands, including major lakes and the isthmus between the two coasts.

maps.title: Patagonia, its Atlantic coast and Tierra del Fuego
maps.scope: The Patagonian mainland and southern archipelagos, from the Andean watersheds to the Atlantic coast, Strait of Magellan and Beagle Channel.

maps.title: Kuk Swamp and the upper Wahgi Valley
maps.scope: The upper Wahgi landscape around Kuk, with Mount Hagen to the west, adjacent wetland basins and the inhabited valley to the east.

maps.title: Chavín de Huántar and the Mosna–Wacheqsa confluence
maps.scope: The archaeological precinct at the river confluence, the neighboring Mosna valley and the mountain slopes that enclose it.

maps.title: Tiwanaku Valley and southern Lake Titicaca
maps.scope: The Tiwanaku precinct, adjoining valley and Altiplano ranges, and the southern Lake Titicaca basin.

maps.title: Teotihuacan and its valley
maps.scope: The ancient urban landscape, including outlying neighborhoods and the valley slopes and volcanic hills around it.

maps.title: Monte Albán and the Valley of Oaxaca
maps.scope: The hilltop city above the junction of the Etla, Tlacolula and Ocotlán–Zimatlán valley arms, with the surrounding mountains.

maps.title: Calakmul and the surrounding tropical forest
maps.scope: The ancient city and wider Calakmul forest, including low-lying seasonal wetlands, the protected landscape and the Mexico–Guatemala border setting.

maps.title: Copán and the Copán River Valley
maps.scope: The river corridor and surrounding foothills, including the Principal Group and Las Sepulturas.

maps.title: Paquimé and the Casas Grandes River valley
maps.scope: The entire settlement and its river valley, with nearby plains and the western foothills.

maps.title: San Agustín and the upper Magdalena
maps.scope: The upper Magdalena valley and gorge landscape around the San Agustín, Alto de los Ídolos and Alto de las Piedras groups.

maps.title: Tierradentro’s tomb groups and mountain valleys
maps.scope: The five named archaeological park components, with the interlocking ridges and valleys around San Andrés de Pisimbalá.

maps.title: Pueblo Bonito and central Chaco Canyon
maps.scope: The great house within the Chaco Wash landscape, together with nearby great houses, canyon walls and the Pueblo Alto mesa.

maps.title: Salmon Pueblo and the San Juan River
maps.scope: The north-bank great house and adjoining San Juan River corridor between Farmington and Bloomfield.

maps.title: Island centers across Micronesia and Polynesia
maps.scope: The ocean-wide setting of the four examples in this guide, from Pohnpei and Tonga to Hawaiʻi and Rapa Nui.
